test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: ‘Courage and Commitment: An Autobiography’ is written by which Indian Politician?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Margaret Alva.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ‘Courage and Commitment: An Autobiography' is written by Margaret Alva.
 
• She is an Indian Politician.
 
• She was the 17th Governor of Goa, 23rd Governor of Gujarat, 20th Governor of Rajasthan and 4th Governor of Uttarakhand the until the end of her tenure in August 2014.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shashi Tharoor **is a member of the Lok Sabha.

 
 
• **The Great Indian Novel Book** is written by **Shashi Tharoor.** 
 
 
 
• **Rahul Gandhi** is a member of the Lok Sabha.
 
• **LK Adani(Lal Krishna Advani)** is an Indian Politician, he is the 7th Deputy Prime Minister of India from 2002 to 2004.
 
 
• He is a former president of the Bharatiya Janata Party(BJP).
 
• **A Prisoner's Scrap Book **is written by ** LK Advani.**
